item.title: Solar storm, geomagnetic storm G2, Moderate: ALERT: Geomagnetic K-index of 6
item.description: Threshold Reached: 2026 Oct 04 2057 UTC. Area of impact primarily poleward of 55 degrees Geomagnetic Latitude. Induced Currents - Power grid fluctuations can occur. High-latitude power systems may experience voltage alarms. Spacecraft - Satellite orientation irregularities may occur; increased drag on low Earth-orbit satellites is possible. Radio - HF (high frequency) radio propagation can fade at higher latitudes. Aurora - Aurora may be seen as low as New York to Wisconsin to Washington state.
